name: Huseyin Atakan Varol
bio: Hüseyin Atakan Varol is the founding director of the Institute of Smart Systems and Artificial Intelligence (ISSAI) at Nazarbayev University in Kazakhstan. Varol's background is in robotics and human-machine interfaces, and Varol has led ISSAI's work on Kazakh-language AI, including the KazLLM models delivered in December 2024.
known_for: Founding director of ISSAI at Nazarbayev University
Led development of the KazLLM Kazakh language model
